title: Floquet analysis of coherence in periodically driven diamond NV ensemble systems
summary: High-density nitrogen-vacancy (NV) ensembles are promising platforms for solid-state quantum sensing, but their performance is limited by dipolar interactions and inhomogeneous dephasing. Periodic decoupling sequences such as Waugh-Huber-Haeberlen (WAHUHA) can extend the observed stroboscopic decay time, but a longer fitted lifetime does not necessarily imply improved magnetic-field sensitivity. Here, we experimentally demonstrate this disconnect experimentally.
